episodes.title: İlk An
episodes.summary: After wreaking havoc at school, Eda, Osman, Sinan and Kerem realize that compassionate teacher Burcu is their only hope against expulsion.

episodes.title: Hayranlık
episodes.summary: With Işık's help, the group sets up Burcu and Kemal on a date at a rock concert. Afterward, Kemal offers to drive Burcu home.

episodes.title: Tutku
episodes.summary: Burcu and Kemal feel a spark, Eda keeps Kerem at arm's length, and Sinan remains reluctant to open up to Işık.

episodes.title: Özlem
episodes.summary: Işık encourages Eda to pursue her dreams. After putting Tuncay through a test, the group realizes he's unworthy of Burcu.

episodes.title: Şefkat
episodes.summary: Osman lures Tuncay into his business scheme — with unexpected consequences. Işık creates an excuse for Burcu and Kemal to work together.

episodes.title: Eğlence
episodes.summary: Eda, Işık and Burcu bond over wine and talk about love. Adult Işık reminisces about the evening when the group celebrated her birthday on the Bosporus.

episodes.title: Değişim
episodes.summary: Tuncay shares unpleasant news with Burcu. An incident at the school lab proves to be the last straw for Necdet, and the crew faces imminent expulsion.

episodes.title: Özel Bir An
episodes.summary: The teachers offer the group one last chance — in exchange for a humiliating public apology. Kemal and Burcu learn the truth about the setup.

episodes.title: Bölüm 1
episodes.summary: Tensions rise between Burcu and Kemal. A furious Işık takes action after hearing about Necdet's secret deal with her friends.

episodes.title: Bölüm 2
episodes.summary: The group enlists Elif's help in their plot to overthrow Necdet by encouraging Refik to put his hat in the ring for the director position.

episodes.title: Bölüm 3
episodes.summary: A smitten Elif is devastated by a misunderstanding with Osman. Kerem encourages Eda to pursue her art. Kemal takes Sinan under his wing.

episodes.title: Bölüm 4
episodes.summary: All hope seems lost for Işık, who parts ways with the group, but Elif urges her to reconsider. Kerem reckons with a heartrending decision.

episodes.title: Bölüm 5
episodes.summary: Kerem swoops in when Eda's parents set her up with a suitor. Osman's free food scheme causes a rumpus at school. Sparks fly between Elif and Osman.

episodes.title: Bölüm 6
episodes.summary: Kerem and Eda arrive at an impasse. Necdet walks into Osman's trap. Bristling under parental pressure, Elif takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Bölüm 7
episodes.summary: The crew gears up for exams. Elif changes her tune during her recital. Necdet maneuvers his way out of an investigation and frames Yıldıray.

episodes.title: Bölüm 8
episodes.summary: A day of reckoning looms for Necdet. Elif leaves for Vienna, and Osman finds a way to make Kerem study.
